scope: One separately supervised engineering diagnostic, reusing exact V4 qualified runtime/modules/authenticated loader and unchanged immutable diagnostic. No fit/qualification/TEST admission.

physical_reuse.process_control: Same ordinary Popen start_new_session, exact parent/session/process-group/argv/interpreter/cwd/namespaces, own-session RSS scan, PID-start guard, TERM then KILL on own child group only, wait4 kernel peak and CPU costs.
physical_reuse.CUDA_control: Same normal in-child daemon observation pattern, persistent allocated/reserved peak maxima, 0.25s cadence, fail-closed cap/monitor exits88/89 and final driver-peak merge; no resets, source hooks or model hooks. Diagnostic needs no per-arm reset capture.
physical_reuse.binding_changes: New diagnostic-only admission/output/source pins; original qualification call and qualification acceptance are replaced with the exact reviewed diagnostic call and diagnostic completion/neutrality coverage.

runtime_loader_reuse.runtime_stdlib: Exact V4 pilot_common.runtime_stdlib with pinned interpreter and distribution versions.
runtime_loader_reuse.runtime: Exact V4 pilot_model.runtime authenticates normal one-device Torch/CUDA/profile/source/binaries/sampler/device properties; the sampler is not called.
runtime_loader_reuse.modules: Exact V4 pilot_model.modules imports pinned prototype/native/design modules with unchanged source paths.
runtime_loader_reuse.data: Exact V4 pilot_data.load_data authenticates original TRAIN/raw/VALID bytes and tensor identities. No new reader or unsafe checkpoint input.
runtime_loader_reuse.teacher: Exact V4 ObservationTeacher.from_train on complete TRAIN graph only.
runtime_loader_reuse.runtime_context: Minimal authority/runtime/prototype/design/cuda-visible context for these existing helpers. Existing failed full_graph release is neither used nor expanded.

publication_neutrality.writer: A closure containing only one exclusive owned Path; its sole receipt argument is recursively checked to be exact plain None/str/int/bool/finite-float/list/dict with plain string keys. Stdlib JSON/open/flush/fsync/os.replace/fixed temporary path only. No input mutation, custom encoder, scientific call, random filename generator, frame inspection or model hook.
publication_neutrality.model_optimizer_data_flags: Exact source proof: writer/validator have no model, optimizer, data or scientific module references and cannot touch training flags. This is an explicit static boundary; live model flags are not dynamically inspected by the runner. Diagnostic itself records flags.
publication_neutrality.runtime_RNG_checks: Each callback records complete Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/all-visible-CUDA RNG component digests and normalized actual runtime profile before and after diagnostic write; it asserts neutrality again after audit-file write before returning.
publication_neutrality.final_call: The diagnostic final publication is included. Runner also requires caller full RNG/runtime profile equality after diagnostic.run returns, so neutrality is checked after the immutable diagnostic's pre-publication final restoration check.
publication_neutrality.count_basis: 12 immediate post-native-step publications + 12 completed step/snapshot publications + 4 comparison publications + 1 finally publication.
publication_neutrality.normalization: Pinned runtime settings are canonicalized through JSON to plain scalar types; TorchVersion string subclasses cannot reach the strict audit writer.

complete_graph_and_work.graph: same authenticated complete real TRAIN graph
complete_graph_and_work.teacher: unchanged ObservationTeacher.from_train from complete TRAIN observations
complete_graph_and_work.data_mutation: Only a trajectory-local clone of pairs receives the four fixed negative replacements.

common_initial_state: Exact immutable diagnostic creates/restores one fresh saved-V3 CPU model/Adam/full-RNG/flags state across J/F V3_A,V3_B,V4_C; no fitted or failed-run state input.
arithmetic_tolerance: Original qualified atol=rtol=128*finfo(actual.dtype).eps, float32 1.52587890625e-5, unchanged; diagnostic observations do not create a qualification PASS.

availability.check_time: Normal supervisor samples nvidia-smi inventory and /proc/meminfo immediately before child creation, after source/admission checks.

required_admission_fields.root_authorization_reference: Root must fill a real authorization/review reference; no admission is created by preparation.
required_admission_fields.normal_supervision_manifest_sha256: Must equal the final sealed MANIFEST SHA of this exact runner/supervisor packet.

prospective_entrypoint: Qualified python -B supervise_diagnostic.py --root-admission <exact new ROOT_DIAGNOSTIC_ADMISSION.json> --admission-sha256 <exact file SHA> --output <exact new supervision/run01>; root must perform normal current-route dispatch separately after review/admission.

cost_custody.inclusive_scope: Supervisor starts its clock before admission/source hashes/device availability/child setup; includes qualified runtime, authenticated data and teacher load, all 12 diagnostic updates and CPU summaries/atomic receipts, failures and final accounting. Kernel child peak, observed session RSS and persistent CUDA peaks are retained.
cost_custody.preparation_scope: Local stdlib text writing, AST and byte-hash inspection only; no scientific imports, numerics, upload or launch.

runtime_failure_handling: Separate child/runner/supervisor failure receipts and terminal cost capture. No retry or resume. Incomplete callbacks/partial current optimizer call remain diagnostic failures, never qualification substitutes.
